target: Daegu brand annual average sales range midpoint proxy; not exact sales
forecast_origin: before target accounting year; latest input accounting year t-2, report year t-1
publication_limit: Actual historical publication dates/vintages unavailable; report-year lag is an approximation, retrospective experiment only
features: two consecutive prior positive ranges t-2/t-3, their store counts and prior industry; no target metadata
secondary_metrics: relative distance to disclosed target range
selection: best baseline and best model on development only; both frozen before evaluation
adoption_gate: at least 5% primary error reduction pooled 2023/2024, improvement in each year and no worse relative range-distance overall; even passing requires data/publication checks before service
range_note: midpoints are proxies; zero/missing ranges excluded, no zero imputation; no guarantee for new/undisclosed brands
